description: Install the user's Ed25519 public key on the included website VM and return verified SSH instructions through the restricted relay. Send only the public key. Read get_free_resource_action until complete, use the returned host keys, test the connection and give the user the returned command. This does not expose direct database SSH.

request_key.description: Stable request key. Reuse it after a timeout; never repeat an unknown command with a new key.

name: get_free_website_ssh
